Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list 
 I1, 
 to be performed on an (1/4) annually bases as indicated by M3 above title 
 block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Sherif Kamal Assy, tested by eng. Mohamed 
 Hussein Sherif, accepted by general manager eng. Mohamed Kamel Afify and 
 approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector of Damanhour power station 
 & MPIS coordinator.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued 
 and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety 
 category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc
Stop the unit
Open the drain valves for (all boiler parts)
Tools 
and Equipment
Workshop kit ( spanners & 
 wrenches)
Screw drivers &
 gear pullers ... etc
General purpose grease
Power supply panel
Hoisting
Graphite backing
Welding equipment
Work to be 
carried out
Operate to check the performance
Define the troubles
Disassemble the defective units
Remove the insulation
Check external body and joints
Check the flanges & setting & pivots & glands
Check the external isolating cover
Check the inner parts (screw, disk & seat)
Check for any corrosion in the body
Check the all parts
Cleaning all parts
Assembling the element & closed the doors
Check the valve (manual & electrical) for open and close
Check the valve condition (open & close) manual & electrical
Adjust the valve stroke
Check after repairing
Restoring all valves to the operating normal position
Cleaning the area after repairing
